title: Our Park and Lake
text:
Our town has a big park. There are many trees and a small lake. Birds live in the trees. Every morning, people walk in the park.

Last summer, the lake was very dirty. Children could not swim there. Now, volunteers clean the water every week. The lake is clean again, and fish live there.

options: Many trees and a small lake

questions.text: What could children not do last summer?
Why are volunteers cleaning the lake?
options: To make the water clean for people and fish

questions.text: How do the people in the town probably feel about the park?

vocabulary.definition: a large public area with grass and trees
a large area of water surrounded by land
people who do work without being paid
to make something free from dirt

paragraph_translations: Nasze miasto ma duży park. Jest w nim wiele drzew i małe jezioro. Ptaki mieszkają na drzewach. Każdego ranka ludzie spacerują po parku.
Zeszłego lata jezioro było bardzo brudne. Dzieci nie mogły w nim pływać. Teraz wolontariusze czyszczą wodę co tydzień. Jezioro jest znowu czyste i żyją w nim ryby.
